pr_title: executor: try to optimize index lookup query may send too many cop task
pr_body: ### What problem does this PR solve? Issue Number: close #53871 Problem Summary: as title said, see more info in issue #53871 ### What changed and how does it work? Increate index lookup executor initial batch size. This PR can reduce the CPU consumption and improve QPS of index-lookup queries with more than 1024 rows. ### Bench Bench index lookup query with different rows by 20 concurrency. See more workload details in #53871 - TiKV cop req ops is much less than before. - Per query's CPU usage is less than before. | Version | Index lookup rows | P99 Duration | P80 Duration | QPS | TiKV Cop Req OPS | All TiDB avg CPU usage | All TiKV avg CPU usage | avg CPU usage (TiDB + TiKV) per query | |---------|-------------------|--------------|--------------|-------|------------------|------------------------|------------------------|---------------------------------------| | Before | 20000 | 508ms | 425ms | 71 | 35.7k | 496% | 1904% | 33.8% | | This PR | 20000 | 505ms | 366ms | 82 | 8.28k | 316% | 1704% | 24.6% | | Before | 8000 | 256ms | 225ms | 124 | 41.7k | 433% | 1630% | 16.6% | | This PR | 8000 | 248ms | 124ms | 188 | 18.8k | 446% | 1751% | 11.7% | | Before | 1200 | 78.5ms | 56.3ms | 490 | 87k | 506% | 2005% | 5.12% | | This PR | 1200 | 63.2ms | 46.4ms | 646 | 65.5k | 477% | 2002% | 3.8% | | Before | 2000 | 115ms | 58.3ms | 434 | 61.1k | 431% | 2015% | 5.6% | | This PR | 2000 | 83.9ms | 56.5ms | 492 | 50k | 408% | 2020% | 4.9% | | Before | 128 | 30.7ms | 15.2ms | 1.49k | 109k | 618% | 1728% | 1.57% | | This PR | 128 | 30.7ms | 15.2ms | 1.49k | 108k | 612% | 1767% | 1.59% | | Before | 50 | 21.6ms | 13.6ms | 2.18k | 87k | 617% | 1444% | 0.95% | | This PR | 50 | 21ms | 13.6ms | 2.18k | 87.1k | 614% | 1487% | 0.96% | #### Sysbench ### Check List Tests - [ ] Unit test - [ ] Integration test - [x] Manual test (add detailed scripts or steps below) - [ ] No need to test > - [ ] I checked and no code files have been changed. > Side effects - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more CPU - [ ] Performance regression: Consumes more Memory - [ ] Breaking backward compatibility Documentation - [ ] Affects user behaviors - [ ] Contains syntax changes - [ ] Contains variable changes - [ ] Contains experimental features - [ ] Changes MySQL compatibility ### Release note Please refer to [Release Notes Language Style Guide](https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/release-notes-style-guide.html) to write a quality release note. ```release-note None ```
